mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_admin_history ( hosp_div_id, admin_id, user_id, action_cd ) VALUES ( #{hospitalDomain}, #{adminId}, #{userId}, #{actionCode} )
mapper.select: SELECT h.history_id AS history_id, h.admin_id AS admin_id, h.user_id AS user_id, e.emp_nm AS user_name, w.ward_nm AS ward_name, h.action_cd AS action_code, h.created_at AS created_at FROM tb_admin_history h LEFT JOIN tb_emp e ON e.hosp_div_id = h.hosp_div_id AND e.emp_id = h.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_ward w ON w.hosp_div_id = e.hosp_div_id AND w.ward_id = e.ward_id WHERE h.hosp_div_id = #{hospitalDomain} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.history_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
